❓ Aksar Pooche Gaye Sawaal

Aapke Sawaalon ke Jawab

🚶 Walk-in allowed hai ya advance booking zaruri?
Haan, walk-in allowed hai! Lekin bridal aur special services ke liye advance booking recommended hai — taaki aapko wait na karna pade. WhatsApp par 1–2 din pehle message karein aur apna slot secure karein.
⏰ Opening hours kya hain?
Monday – Saturday: Subah 9:00 AM se Raat 8:00 PM
Sunday: Subah 10:00 AM se Shaam 6:00 PM
Tyoharon par timing change ho sakti hai — WhatsApp par confirm karein.
👰 Bridal package mein kya-kya included hai?
Bridal package mein pre-bridal facial, bridal makeup (HD/airbrush), hair styling, saree/lehenga draping aur ek trial session shaamil hai. Package ₹1,500 se start hota hai. Full pricing ke liye WhatsApp karein.
🏠 Kya aap home service bhi deti hain?
Haan! Bridal aur special occasion makeup ke liye home service available hai. Haldwani aur nearby areas mein travel charges applicable hain. WhatsApp par apna address share karein aur quote lein.
💳 Payment methods kya-kya accepted hain?
Cash, UPI (PhonePe, GPay, Paytm) aur card payments sabhi accepted hain. Bridal bookings ke liye 50% advance deposit required hoti hai slot confirm karne ke liye.
🕐 Service mein kitna time lagta hai?
Facial: 45–60 min  |  Haircut & Styling: 30–60 min
Bridal Makeup + Hair: 2–4 hours  |  Manicure/Pedicure: 45 min
Bridal ke liye hamesha thoda extra time rakhein.
📅 Advance booking zaruri hai?
Bridal, engagement aur special event makeup ke liye 1–2 week advance booking strongly recommended hai. Regular services ke liye 1–2 din pehle WhatsApp karein. Weekend par slots jaldi bhar jaate hain — jaldi book karein!
💄 Kya aap trial makeup bhi deti hain?
Haan! Bridal package mein ek free trial session included hai. Aap shaadi se 1–2 hafte pehle trial kar sakti hain taaki apna final look confirm ho sake. Trial se aapko exact idea milta hai ki makeup kaisa dikhega.
